targets.query:
import "date"

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: date.add(d: 1ns, to: v.timeRangeStop))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "screenshot_step_replay" and r._field == "value" and r.trace == "blue")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> group(columns: [])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
